timingBasis: Scene cuts conformed to measured paragraph pauses in the selected narration; English caption phrases timed within each spoken scene.

features.school_branding: Own short school link, logo, motto and colours
features.phone_pin: Staff and parent phone + four-digit PIN; owner email/password
features.school_app: School-branded home-screen installation on supported devices
features.offline_sync: Prepared teacher/Mu’allim offline attendance, scores and memorization; automatic reconnect sync
features.payroll_categories: Teaching/non-teaching salary sheets without unnecessary teacher accounts
features.quran_tracker: Optional Tahfeez, Surah/Ayah, Mumtaz/Jayyid and Halqah management
features.dual_role: One assigned teacher login for My Class and My Subjects
features.a4_reports: Fixed standard A4 reports scaled across devices and printed with intact margins

roles.title: School Owner / Principal
roles.audience: The school owner configuring branding, school accounts, programmes, payroll and reporting.

scenes.title: Your own school, your own link
scenes.onScreen: Your school. Your crest. Your own link.
scenes.narration: Welcome to NDH SchoolOS, where your school’s short link opens its own crest, motto and colours, for example, ndhschoolos dot app, slash s, slash markaz.
actions: Open the approved school’s short link in a fresh browser tab. Show the example address ndhschoolos.app/s/markaz in an editorial callout, labelled example.
Hold on the school crest, name, motto and saved colours. Do not expose student records before login.
scenes.verification: The copied link opens the intended school; its public page shows branding only. The example alias is not presented as a verified live school.

scenes.title: Owner email and password
scenes.onScreen: Owner: email + password | Staff and parents: phone + 4-digit PIN
scenes.narration: Owners use email and password, while staff and parents use a registered phone number and four-digit PIN, shared privately.
actions: Select the owner email/password route and sign in using an approved recording account. Mask all credentials.
Cut to School portal & accounts to show a provisioned staff account and a parent linked only to their children; never reveal the PIN.
scenes.verification: No school code, email address or email inbox is required in the staff/parent phone-login sequence; school link alone grants no private access.

scenes.title: Set and share your school identity
scenes.onScreen: Save branding → Copy school link → Share privately
scenes.narration: Save your school branding and short link, then copy the link for staff and families to open the right school page.
actions: Show the existing branding settings and School portal & accounts → Short school link. Use the approved school alias, not a live third party’s name.
Copy the saved school portal link; open it in a second tab to verify the brand.
scenes.verification: Use actual saved school colours and crest; do not restyle the website or fabricate a branded screenshot.

scenes.title: Install the school’s own app
scenes.onScreen: Install school app • School name and crest
scenes.narration: Tap Install school app for your school’s crest and name on the home screen, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone.
actions: Record the published school page on Android Chrome and its actual Install school app action. Show the confirmed home-screen icon and launch it.
Include a short iPhone Safari Share → Add to Home Screen inset. Use a saved PNG or JPEG school crest.
scenes.verification: Capture a real supported browser/device installation, not an editor preview or an app-store download. Verify both the icon/name and the school opened on launch.

scenes.title: Teaching roles and one login
scenes.onScreen: One login • My Class / My Subjects
scenes.narration: Give dual-role teachers one login for My Class and My Subjects, with only their assigned home class, Halqah and subjects.
actions: Show the owner assigning both a home class and subjects to one approved teacher.
Insert a labelled teacher-perspective shot showing the two task views under the same signed-in identity.
scenes.verification: Confirm both assignments are authorised for this teacher. Match the deployed navigation wording; do not invent clickable controls or expose another school’s records.

scenes.title: Everyone belongs on payroll, not in a teacher portal
scenes.onScreen: Teaching staff | Non-teaching staff
scenes.narration: Payroll separates teaching staff from nannies, security guards, cleaners, drivers and cooks, without unnecessary teacher logins.
actions: Open Staff & Payroll. Show Teaching staff and Non-teaching staff filters.
Use approved support-staff fixtures for the five duties; display a salary sheet and the absence of teaching assignments/login provisioning for these people.
scenes.verification: Non-teaching staff appear in payroll totals and salary sheets without being granted teacher access. Mask bank details and salaries unless the fixtures are explicitly approved.

scenes.title: Keep Tahfeez optional
scenes.onScreen: Conventional: academics only | Islamic / dual-stream: optional Tahfeez
scenes.narration: Conventional schools keep academic terms, while Islamic or dual-stream schools can enable Tahfeez, Halqahs, Surah and Ayah logs, with Mumtaz or Jayyid ratings.
actions: Show the conventional configuration with the Qur’an module disabled and no Tahfeez-only terms in its navigation.
Cut to an authorised Islamic or dual-stream configuration, enable the existing tracker and show group management plus a dated Surah/Ayah entry and rating.
scenes.verification: The two configurations are explicit alternatives, not a forced conversion of every school. Verify deployed rating labels; use the real equivalents if translations differ.

scenes.title: Offline work, then automatic sync
scenes.onScreen: Online setup → Offline drafts → Reconnect → Confirm sync
scenes.narration: After online sign-in, teachers and Mu’allims can draft attendance, CA and exam scores, and memorization offline, then sync automatically when reconnected.
actions: Use the published, previously opened school app with an approved teaching/Mu’allim account. Turn off network connectivity and show the offline indicator.
Record attendance, an assessment score and a dated memorization entry; keep local-save indicators visible. Reconnect with the app open and show successful synchronization.
scenes.verification: Confirm the records persist after an online reload, preferably on a second authorised device. A deliberate stale-edit conflict must show review, not a silent overwrite; new sign-ins, payments and messages still require internet.

scenes.title: Exact A4 reports on every screen
scenes.onScreen: Fixed A4 report • Phone / tablet / computer
scenes.narration: Report cards stay fixed A4 on phone, tablet and computer, so check the complete page and margins before printing.
actions: Open the same approved report on phone, tablet and desktop. Show the crest and identical content arrangement.
Open print preview, select A4 portrait, turn browser headers/footers off if present, and inspect every page edge before producing a PDF or physical print.
scenes.verification: Use the configured school report template. Do not change the template or crop page edges to conceal clipping; confirm no extra blank page.

scenes.title: Share the right link and confirm readiness
scenes.onScreen: School link ✓ Accounts ✓ Install ✓ Offline sync ✓ A4 ✓
scenes.narration: Before sharing access, test each role, school-app installation, offline sync and A4 printing, keeping PINs and school records private.
actions: End on the approved school’s branded page and a concise readiness checklist.
Use the existing NDH branding and Navy #0a192f for editorial title cards only; leave the product UI unchanged.
scenes.verification: No platform-wide owner, other-school data or secret credentials appear in the closing frame.

roles.summary: School branding & short links → Secure role sign-in → Install school app → Dual-role teachers → Support-staff payroll → Optional tracker → Offline sync → A4 reports.

roles.title: Exam Officer
roles.audience: The assigned exam officer reviewing papers and coordinating permitted school-wide results.

scenes.title: Your school’s assessment workspace
scenes.onScreen: Exam Officer • Your school’s branded page
scenes.narration: Welcome, Exam Officer, open your school’s short link and check its crest, motto and colours before entering your assessment workspace.
actions: Open the authorised school page from its shared short link and hold on the school identity.
Keep private records hidden until authentication.
scenes.verification: School branding matches the recording tenant; the public page is not used as proof of authorisation.

scenes.title: Phone and four-digit PIN
scenes.onScreen: Phone number + 4-digit PIN • No email needed
scenes.narration: Staff use a registered phone number and four-digit PIN, with no email needed, while the owner uses email and password.
actions: Select staff phone login on the branded school page. Mask the registered number and all PIN digits.
Show the exam officer’s name and permitted workspace after successful sign-in.
scenes.verification: Use an owner-provisioned exam officer account, not a browser role switch.

scenes.title: Install your school app
scenes.onScreen: Install school app → Launch from school crest
scenes.narration: Install school app adds the school crest and name to your home screen, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone.
actions: Record installation in a supported published browser and launch the school-branded icon.
Use a brief iPhone instruction inset if the main capture is Android.
scenes.verification: The installed app reopens the same school; no generic NDH-only icon is substituted for the configured crest.

scenes.title: Track and review exam papers
scenes.onScreen: Missing papers → Review → Return or approve
scenes.narration: Track missing exam papers, review submissions, return corrections or approve them, then use the existing PDF and Word exports.
actions: Show the missing-paper tracker, an approved fixture submission, its review actions and available exports.
Avoid exposing answer keys alongside parent-facing footage.
scenes.verification: Only authorised exam-officer actions are shown; publication and approval are not presented as the same step.

scenes.title: Understand a dual-role teacher’s submissions
scenes.onScreen: One teacher login • Home class + assigned subjects
scenes.narration: A dual-role teacher keeps one login for My Class and My Subjects, with marks attached to their assigned learners.
actions: Insert a labelled teacher-perspective shot of both authorised task views, then return to the exam officer’s review workspace.
Keep the same teacher identity visible across the two task views.
scenes.verification: Do not imply that switching views grants new subjects or lets an exam officer edit unrelated classes as that teacher.

scenes.title: Account for offline score drafts
scenes.onScreen: Offline teacher drafts → Reconnect → Synced scores
scenes.narration: Teachers can draft CA and exam scores offline after online sign-in, then sync automatically on reconnect, so confirm the latest marks before publishing.
actions: Use a labelled teacher cutaway to save a fixture score while disconnected; reconnect and show confirmed sync.
Return to the exam officer session and reload or refresh the relevant result view after that confirmation.
scenes.verification: Do not imply the exam officer can see a still-offline teacher’s unsynced drafts. Show conflicts as requiring review.

scenes.title: Respect the school’s programme
scenes.onScreen: Academic terms by default • Tahfeez only when enabled
scenes.narration: Conventional schools keep academic terms, while enabled Islamic or dual-stream schools add optional Tahfeez, Halqahs, Surah and Ayah progress.
actions: Show separate conventional and enabled Islamic/dual-stream views, clearly labelled.
Use a short contextual insert for Surah, Ayah and the school’s memorization-rating labels; do not perform unassigned Mu’allim edits.
scenes.verification: Optional Qur’an terminology is not placed into the conventional-school navigation.

scenes.title: Check full A4 report cards
scenes.onScreen: Standard A4 • Same paper layout on every screen
scenes.narration: Check the same fixed A4 report on phone, tablet and computer, inspect every print margin, and release results only through the approved publication process.
actions: Show an authorised report and broadsheet workflow; switch screen widths without changing the report’s content or template.
Show full A4 print preview and the approved result-publication step, if assigned.
scenes.verification: No clipped margins, extra blank pages or unpublished parent results are represented as ready to distribute.

roles.summary: School phone/PIN login → Install app → Paper review & exports → Teacher drafts and sync → Programme-aware results → Exact A4 reports.

roles.title: Class Teacher / Mu’allim
roles.audience: An assigned class teacher, with an optional Mu’allim/Halqah recording variant for enabled schools.

scenes.title: Your class or Halqah, in your school
scenes.onScreen: Class Teacher / Mu’allim • Your school identity
scenes.narration: Welcome, Class Teacher or Mu’allim, open your school’s short link and check its own crest, motto and colours.
actions: Open the approved school’s branded link. Introduce the academic class-teacher cut and label the optional Mu’allim variant.
scenes.verification: Never suggest that a branded link alone reveals class lists or attendance.

scenes.title: One simple staff sign-in
scenes.onScreen: Registered phone number + 4-digit PIN
scenes.narration: Sign in with your registered phone number and four-digit PIN, without email or a password, to see only your assigned learners.
actions: Mask phone/PIN entry; show successful authentication and the assigned roster.
Do not use an owner account to simulate a teacher’s access.
scenes.verification: The signed-in role and roster match the approved fixture account.

scenes.title: Your school on the home screen
scenes.onScreen: Install school app • Your school’s crest and name
scenes.narration: Install school app gives your phone the school crest and name, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone, then sign in online first.
actions: Show real supported-browser installation and launch from the configured school icon.
Leave the published app open long enough to save its permitted records before disconnecting.
scenes.verification: Offline reopening is demonstrated in the published app, not the editor preview.

scenes.title: My Class and My Subjects
scenes.onScreen: One login → My Class ↔ My Subjects
scenes.narration: Dual-role teachers switch between My Class and My Subjects under one login, including assigned Halqah and subject duties.
actions: Use a fixture teacher with both assignments. Show the two deployed task views and unchanged signed-in identity.
Select the home class, then an assigned subject; return without signing out.
scenes.verification: Verify the actual deployed labels and role permissions; no duplicate account or school-wide access is implied.

scenes.title: Take attendance without data
scenes.onScreen: Offline • Daily attendance saved as a draft
scenes.narration: Without data or Wi-Fi, take daily attendance in the saved app and check the local draft indicator for your class or Halqah.
actions: After an online sign-in, disable mobile data and Wi-Fi. Open the saved roster and mark a dated fixture attendance record.
Show the offline/local-draft state and do not replace it with a cloud-saved badge.
scenes.verification: The edited roster stays within the teacher’s class or Halqah and remains available offline.

scenes.title: Record CA and exam scores offline
scenes.onScreen: Offline • CA and exam score drafts
scenes.narration: Record CA and exam scores offline for your assigned subjects, keeping drafts on this device until your connection returns.
actions: Keep the network disabled; enter one CA score and one exam score within allowed ranges.
Switch between the authorised subject and class task views and show the saved draft indicator.
scenes.verification: Do not describe local-only changes as already visible to the exam officer or another device.

scenes.title: Optional daily Tahfeez records
scenes.onScreen: Optional Tahfeez • Surah • Ayah • Mumtaz / Jayyid
scenes.narration: Where enabled, the Tahfeez Tracker records daily Surah and Ayah ranges for your Halqah, with Mumtaz or Jayyid ratings and offline drafts.
actions: Use the separately labelled Mu’allim variant in an authorised enabled school; show the date, assigned Halqah and Surah/Ayah fields.
Record a permitted rating with no network. In the conventional cut, replace this scene with academic attendance/remarks and a brief optional-feature card.
scenes.verification: Keep Qur’an-only fields out of the conventional workflow. Match the real rating options; do not invent controls if translated labels differ.

scenes.title: Reconnect and confirm automatic sync
scenes.onScreen: Reconnect → Automatic sync → Check saved records
scenes.narration: Reconnect to upload and sync drafts automatically, wait for confirmation, and review conflicts instead of overwriting newer work.
actions: Restore connectivity. Show the real sync progress and acknowledgement for attendance, scores and, in the Mu’allim variant, memorization.
Reload online or inspect from a second authorised session to confirm persistence.
scenes.verification: Successful acknowledgement is required before the scene says synced; sign-out clears device copies, so do not sign out with pending drafts.

scenes.title: Preview and print exact A4 reports
scenes.onScreen: Phone / tablet / desktop • One fixed A4 layout
scenes.narration: Report cards keep the same fixed A4 layout on phone, tablet and computer, so inspect full margins and remember parents see published results only.
actions: Open an allowed learner report at phone, tablet and desktop widths. Show the same template and complete page border.
Select A4 portrait in print preview and check for clipped edges or unwanted extra pages.
scenes.verification: A teacher’s draft or review preview is not described as automatically published to parents.

roles.summary: School phone/PIN login → Install app → My Class / My Subjects → Offline attendance & scores → Optional Tahfeez → Reconnect sync → A4 reports.

roles.title: Subject Teacher
roles.audience: A subject teacher, including staff who also hold a home-class or Halqah assignment.

scenes.title: Open your school’s own page
scenes.onScreen: Subject Teacher • Your school’s short link
scenes.narration: Welcome, Subject Teacher, use your school’s own short link and check its crest, motto and colours before entering your subject workspace.
actions: Show the school’s branded short link and the correct identity before login.
scenes.verification: No school code is entered as an authentication credential.

scenes.title: Phone and PIN, not email
scenes.onScreen: Phone number + 4-digit PIN • One staff account
scenes.narration: Sign in with your registered phone number and four-digit PIN, without email or a password, for your assigned subjects and learners only.
actions: Mask all credentials; sign in as the approved subject teacher and show the allowed subject list.
scenes.verification: Do not expose a real PIN or claim access to unassigned classes.

scenes.title: Install the school-branded app
scenes.onScreen: Install school app → School crest on home screen
scenes.narration: Install school app adds your school’s crest and name, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone, and sign in online first.
actions: Record the actual installation action in a supported browser and launch the school-branded icon.
scenes.verification: Do not present app installation as a new account or an app-store download.

scenes.title: Switch tasks without another login
scenes.onScreen: My Subjects ↔ My Class • Same login
scenes.narration: If you also handle a home class or Halqah, switch between My Subjects and My Class without another login.
actions: Capture one teacher with both home-class/Halqah and subject assignments. Show the two real task views with unchanged identity.
scenes.verification: Confirm deployed wording before recording; view switching does not grant additional responsibilities.

scenes.title: Teach a subject across assigned groups
scenes.onScreen: Assigned subjects • Combined groups • Correct home classes
scenes.narration: Use configured combined teaching groups to enter each learner’s marks once and keep their correct home-class records connected.
actions: Show a configured combined group, its member classes and a permitted fixture score.
Return to each relevant home-class result view without re-entering the score.
scenes.verification: Do not imply that one score should be copied to unrelated subjects or unassigned learners.

scenes.title: Keep scoring when the internet stops
scenes.onScreen: Offline • CA and exam drafts • Automatic sync on reconnect
scenes.narration: Record CA and exam scores offline, then reconnect for automatic draft sync, waiting for confirmation before expecting others to see updates.
actions: Disconnect, enter CA/exam fixture scores and show local draft status.
Reconnect with the app open, show the real success acknowledgement and verify the persisted scores online.
scenes.verification: Show conflict review if a newer score exists; do not simulate silent overwrite or promise first-time offline authentication.

scenes.title: Only the programmes you handle
scenes.onScreen: Optional Tahfeez • Assigned Mu’allim duties only
scenes.narration: Conventional schools keep academic terms, while assigned Mu’allims in enabled schools can record Tahfeez, Surah, Ayah and memorization ratings offline.
actions: Use a clearly labelled optional Mu’allim-assigned cutaway, not an unrelated subject teacher’s account.
Show one dated assigned Halqah entry and its local-save status; otherwise use an optional-feature explanatory card only.
scenes.verification: Do not imply every subject teacher can open or edit all Qur’an records. Use real deployed rating labels.

scenes.title: Prepare exams and check A4 output
scenes.onScreen: Exam workflow • Correct scores • Fixed A4 reports
scenes.narration: Submit exam questions for review, request score changes through the approved workflow, and check the complete fixed A4 report before printing.
actions: Show the existing question preparation/submission workflow, retaining paper review and score-edit request permissions.
Use an authorised report preview at phone and desktop sizes, then full A4 print preview.
scenes.verification: Do not imply the teacher can approve their own paper, unlock results, or publish parent reports without permission.

roles.summary: School phone/PIN login → Install app → Dual-role teaching → Combined groups → Offline scores & sync → Exam review → A4 reports.

roles.title: Bursar / Accountant
roles.audience: The authorised bursar handling fees, verified receipts, debts and staff payroll.

scenes.title: Finance in your own school workspace
scenes.onScreen: Bursar • Your school’s link and branding
scenes.narration: Welcome, Bursar, your school’s short link opens its own crest, motto and colours, with private finance records hidden until sign-in.
actions: Show the approved school-branded page, then the authorised finance workspace after login.
scenes.verification: Mask all real financial and bank information; use authorised recording fixtures.

scenes.title: Simple staff phone login
scenes.onScreen: Phone number + 4-digit PIN
scenes.narration: Use your registered phone number and four-digit PIN, without email or a password, to enter your authorised bursar workspace.
actions: Show the staff phone login and the bursar identity; mask phone/PIN entry.
scenes.verification: No owner credentials or teacher identity are used to stand in for the bursar.

scenes.title: Install the school app
scenes.onScreen: School crest + school name on your phone
scenes.narration: Install school app adds your school’s crest and name, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone, and sign in online first.
actions: Demonstrate a real supported installation and the school opened from the installed icon.
scenes.verification: Use the published school page and approved crest, not a generic mocked icon.

scenes.title: Set and review school fees
scenes.onScreen: Fees • Discounts • Waivers • Correct balances
scenes.narration: Check the correct session, term, fee schedule, sibling discounts and approved waivers before confirming each learner’s invoice balance.
actions: Show approved fee fixtures, the correct term and a permitted sibling discount or waiver.
Open a matching invoice and balance without exposing another learner’s family details.
scenes.verification: Do not imply a discount or waiver is automatically approved by any staff member.

scenes.title: Verify before issuing receipts
scenes.onScreen: Verify transfers → Confirm payment → Official receipt
scenes.narration: Verify bank transfers before confirming payments and issuing receipts, then review debtors, remembering online payments and messages need internet.
actions: Show a fixture pending transfer, its review and confirmed receipt.
Use the permitted debtor/reminder workflow; do not send a real reminder during recording.
scenes.verification: An offline entry or screenshot is not presented as independent bank verification or a completed online payment.

scenes.title: Teaching and non-teaching salary sheets
scenes.onScreen: Teaching staff | Nannies • Security • Cleaners • Drivers • Cooks
scenes.narration: Payroll separates teaching staff from nannies, security guards, cleaners, drivers and cooks on salary sheets, without unnecessary teacher logins.
actions: Open the teaching/non-teaching filters in Staff & Payroll. Show approved fixtures for the five support duties.
Show matching payroll rows and salary sheets; no teaching assignments or automatic login creation should appear for support staff.
scenes.verification: Verify category totals and payout sheets include both groups correctly; mask account numbers and any non-fixture salary amounts.

scenes.title: Wait for school drafts to sync
scenes.onScreen: Teacher offline drafts ≠ verified online payments
scenes.narration: Teachers and Mu’allims can draft attendance, scores and memorization offline and sync automatically on reconnect, but bank checks still require connectivity.
actions: Use a labelled staff offline-to-sync insert, followed by the connected bursar’s reconciliation view.
Keep online-only payment and messaging requirements visible in a lower-third.
scenes.verification: Do not promise offline banking, automatic bank validation, or instant access to another device’s unsynced drafts.

scenes.title: Review and export the correct payroll
scenes.onScreen: Correct school • Correct period • Reviewed payroll export
scenes.narration: Before exporting payroll or receipts, check the school, period, staff category and saved status, keeping salaries, bank details and PINs private.
actions: Review the school name and payroll month, then use the existing export/print actions.
End with the school’s branded page and installed icon.
scenes.verification: No parent or teaching-only account is shown opening private salary sheets.

roles.summary: School phone/PIN login → Install app → Fees & verified receipts → Teaching / non-teaching payroll → Reconciliation & exports.

roles.title: School Secretary
roles.audience: The authorised secretary handling admissions, guardian records, notices and permitted printing.

scenes.title: Your school’s front office
scenes.onScreen: Secretary • Share the correct branded school link
scenes.narration: Welcome, School Secretary, share your school’s own short link, with its crest, motto and colours, rather than a generic school-code login.
actions: Open the approved short link and show the branded public page; prepare a share action without sending a real message.
scenes.verification: The displayed example link is clearly identified as an example if not the approved recording school.

scenes.title: Phone and PIN for staff and parents
scenes.onScreen: Staff and parents: phone + 4-digit PIN | Owner: email + password
scenes.narration: Staff and parents use a registered phone number and four-digit PIN, while only the owner uses email and password, and guardians see linked children only.
actions: Sign in as the approved secretary with masked credentials.
Show guardian phone data in an approved fixture record; use an owner-perspective insert if provisioning a login is demonstrated.
scenes.verification: Do not show the secretary creating accounts unless that deployed role is authorised. Never expose PINs on a printed/public admissions list.

scenes.title: Help families install their school app
scenes.onScreen: Install school app • iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen
scenes.narration: Help families tap Install school app for the school’s own crest and name, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone.
actions: Record Android installation and a short iPhone instruction insert. Launch the actual school icon.
scenes.verification: Do not imply installation links a guardian to children or bypasses their phone/PIN login.

scenes.title: Keep learners and guardian links accurate
scenes.onScreen: Admissions • Guardian checks • Correct class transfers
scenes.narration: Check admissions, guardian details, sibling links and class transfers carefully, keeping learners with the correct authorised roster.
actions: Use approved learner/guardian fixtures for admissions, sibling details and an allowed class transfer.
If collection slips are shown, keep parent confirmation fields blank for the family to complete.
scenes.verification: No real learner records are used without explicit approval; a matching phone is not a reason to reveal unrelated children.

scenes.title: Use the school’s chosen terms
scenes.onScreen: Class or Halqah • Optional Tahfeez • One teacher identity
scenes.narration: Conventional schools keep academic terms, while Islamic or dual-stream schools can enable Tahfeez and Halqahs, with dual-role teachers using My Class and My Subjects under one login.
actions: Show clearly labelled conventional and enabled Islamic/dual-stream roster views.
Use a labelled authorised teacher cutaway for the two task views, not the secretary performing teacher-only edits.
scenes.verification: No Qur’an-only terminology is forced into the conventional school; match deployed labels in the capture.

scenes.title: Coordinate after offline lessons
scenes.onScreen: Offline teaching work → Automatic sync on reconnect
scenes.narration: Teachers and Mu’allims draft attendance, scores and memorization offline after online setup, then sync automatically on reconnect, so wait for confirmation before front-office follow-up.
actions: Show a labelled teacher attendance draft while disconnected and its successful sync after reconnecting.
Return to the secretary’s permitted view and check the updated attendance; keep notices online.
scenes.verification: The secretary is not shown seeing another person’s unsynced offline work or sending messages without connectivity.

scenes.title: Print complete A4 report cards
scenes.onScreen: Fixed A4 • Full margins • Authorised reports only
scenes.narration: Print only authorised reports, checking that the same fixed A4 page scales across phone, tablet and computer with no clipped print margins.
actions: Open an allowed report in read-only printing mode. Show the same page at phone, tablet and desktop widths.
Select A4 portrait; inspect all page edges and the page count before printing.
scenes.verification: No score editing, unapproved publication or margin-cropping workaround is shown.

roles.summary: School phone/PIN login → Help families install → Admissions & guardian links → Programme-aware records → Synced attendance → A4 printing.

roles.title: Parent / Guardian
roles.audience: A parent or guardian using only their school account and linked children’s information.

scenes.title: Your child’s school, straight from its link
scenes.onScreen: Your school’s link • Its crest, motto and colours
scenes.narration: Welcome, Parent or Guardian, open your school’s short link, for example, ndhschoolos dot app, slash s, slash markaz, and check its crest, motto and colours.
actions: Open the approved school link from a prepared message without exposing real contacts.
Hold on the public branding. Label the example address as an example, not a verified account destination.
scenes.verification: No generic school-code step or private learner information appears before authentication.

scenes.title: Your phone number and four-digit PIN
scenes.onScreen: No email needed • Phone number + 4-digit PIN
scenes.narration: Use your registered phone number and privately supplied four-digit PIN, with no email or password needed, and contact your school if you need help.
actions: Select parent phone login; mask all digits. Show a successful approved parent account with only linked children.
scenes.verification: Do not display a reusable example PIN or imply any phone number can open a child’s record.

scenes.title: Keep your school app on your phone
scenes.onScreen: Install school app • Your school’s crest and name
scenes.narration: Tap Install school app for the school crest and name on your home screen, or use Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen on iPhone.
actions: Record a real installation from the published school page and launch the configured school icon.
Include the iPhone sequence as a brief labelled insert.
scenes.verification: Use the supported browser’s actual confirmation; do not claim an app-store download or password-free access after installation.

scenes.title: Only your linked children
scenes.onScreen: Switch linked children • Check attendance
scenes.narration: Choose from your linked children to check attendance and school updates, asking the school to correct any missing or incorrect child link.
actions: Use approved parent fixtures with two linked children. Switch children and open the permitted attendance view.
scenes.verification: No unrelated learner appears in the selector, exported report or cutaway.

scenes.title: Published results and exact A4 reports
scenes.onScreen: Published results • Full A4 report card
scenes.narration: Open published results and the same fixed A4 report on phone, tablet or computer, then check the full page and margins before printing.
actions: Show a published fixture result, not an unpublished teacher draft. Compare the identical report at three screen widths.
Open print preview, select A4 portrait and inspect the full page without clipped edges.
scenes.verification: The parent sees only their linked child’s published report; the page is not cropped or reformatted to fit the phone.

scenes.title: Understand updates from lessons
scenes.onScreen: School updates after sync • Tahfeez only if your school enables it
scenes.narration: Teachers save lesson records offline and sync automatically on reconnect, so updates follow sync and school release rules, with Tahfeez optional for enabled schools.
actions: Use a labelled teacher-perspective offline-to-sync insert; return to the parent view only after acknowledgement.
Use an explanatory optional-feature card for Tahfeez unless the deployed parent account is explicitly permitted to view those records.
scenes.verification: Do not promise instant access to unsynced drafts, unpublished results, or a parent memorization-editing screen. State that first-time sign-in needs internet.

scenes.title: Fees, verified receipts and safe use
scenes.onScreen: Check fees • Confirm receipts • Keep your PIN private
scenes.narration: Check your child’s fees and official receipts, remember that new sign-ins, online payments and messages need internet, and keep your PIN private.
actions: Show approved linked-child fee and confirmed receipt fixtures. Do not initiate a real payment or message.
End on the school-branded home-screen icon with a contact-your-school callout.
scenes.verification: A pending transfer is not described as paid. Do not promise offline online-payments or access to other families’ balances.

roles.summary: Your school link → Phone + 4-digit PIN → Install school app → Linked children → Published A4 reports → Fees & official receipts.

voiceDescription: User-selected English female educational narrator; not a verified Nigerian-English accent.
visualFormat: Illustrated workflow guides, not recordings of a live school account.
